content:
Anya: Quick sync — finalizing the webinar microformat and speaker storyboards. Need each speaker to submit: 1) 2-slide demo storyboard, 2) 3 sample prompts (happy path, edge case, fallback), 3) 30s talking points. Deadline: EOD Wed.
Mike: microformat = the short demo layout, right? like 90s demo + 30s callout?
Anya: yep — target is 90s live demo (1 prompt run) + 30s takeaway + 2 slides. Keeps pace for a 45-min session with panel Qs.
Rachel: ok — can we set rehearsal slots? prefer Tue/Thu afternoon. also need to capture expected outputs for each prompt for evals.
Ben: adding checklist: run-of-show, slide PDF, sample prompts, expected tokens, fallback variant (quantized/cheaper model), and a test harness link.
Anya: exact checklist below — please attach to your speaker thread: 1) storyboard PDF (2 slides) 2) prompts.txt (3 prompts) 3) expected_output.md (1 example per prompt) 4) short bio + headshot
Mike: do you want prompts in plain text or with metadata?
Anya: plain text + a 1-line "what success looks like" note per prompt. e.g. 
```
Prompt: "Summarize this product spec in 3 bullets for PMs"
Success: concise 3 bullets, no hallucinated features
Edge case prompt: very long spec -> model should prioritize top-level items
Fallback: use compact model v2 if latency > 600ms
```
Rachel: can OpsBot create rehearsal Zoom + calendar invites automatically when we claim a slot?
OpsBot: I can — post preferred slots in this thread and I'll create events tagged #webinar-rehearsal.
Ben: schedule suggestion: Tue 3pm rehearsal (full run), Thu 11am tech check (lighting/audio + demo latency checks).
Mike: who owns the Q&A lead? I can if no one else.
Rachel: volunteering to handle audience routing/questions in the first 10 mins of Q&A. Mike can moderate the deeper prompts.
Anya: perfect. final ask: speakers, drop the 2-slide storyboard + prompts into the thread by Wed EOD. We'll run a micro-rehearsal on Tue 15:00 and full dress Thu 11:00. If you hit any model latency > 500ms in dev, tag @Ben and we fallback to the smaller checkpoint. :thumbsup:
